definitions.gloss: bereavement; parting by death; being separated by death
definitions.explanation: The experience of losing someone close through death. Focuses on the separation and loss felt by the surviving person.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}と{死別|しべつ}したのは{十歳|じっさい}のときだった。
examples.english: I was ten years old when I lost my father.

examples.japanese: {愛|あい}する{人|ひと}との{死別|しべつ}は{深|ふか}い{悲|かな}しみをもたらす。
examples.english: The loss of a loved one brings deep sorrow.

examples.japanese: {配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}との{死別|しべつ}を{経験|けいけん}した{人|ひと}を{支援|しえん}するグループがある。
examples.english: There are support groups for people who have experienced the death of a spouse.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, somewhat literary word used to describe the specific type of separation caused by someone's death. Takes と to mark the person one was separated from: ～と{死別|しべつ}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～と{死別|しべつ}する (to be parted from ~ by death)
- {死別|しべつ}を{経験|けいけん}する (to experience bereavement)
- {親|おや}との{死別|しべつ} (losing a parent to death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生|い}き{別|わか}れ: separation from a living person — being separated without death, typically due to circumstances
- {別離|べつり}: separation; parting — literary term for separation in general
